title: Every installed node is refused at startup on dev 6107ceb56: packaging/fn's heap probe decides heap=2416..2433 MB for a fresh 'operator init' store, and the owner started at exactly that figure refuses 'cold startup refused: the process heap does not hold the store's protected runtime' (books/page-read-startup.lisp :default-pool-heap-not-held, protected > dynamic). The figure (books/heap-store-figure.lisp fn-heap-store-figure-octets) and the owner's protected allowance (fn-heap-runtime-protected-octets, via fn-prstartup-protected) both include fn-heap-core-dynamic = the CALLING process's sb-kernel:dynamic-usage (host/native/heap.lisp fnn-heap-image-observation): the probe process's usage sizes the figure, the owner's own (larger, by ~17 MB) is checked against it, with no slack between them. Observed on hbox, published set 6107ceb56, production image, 24G scope: the same store's probe printed 2433 once and 2416 the next; launcher starts refused 6 of 6; the image started directly at 2433..16000 MB listens. Red: smoke-6107ceb56 (hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/scenarios-2/native-smoke-6107ceb56), 23 refused starts in 10 of 15 modules under the decided-launch harness (lane/scenarios e14259ca3, not yet on dev). Batch 6 natives did not see it: they start at the image's saved 32000 MB. Successor of cold-start's 'invalid runtime capture' (95d8fd0f0 threaded the store observation, not the core usage).
